description: A chief commercial counsel must decide whether to approve a customer-support AI platform agreement and finalize the data-use, security, insurance, and audit protections, with input from privacy counsel, insurance counsel, and customer contracts counsel.

shared_context.S1: The company plans to use the vendor's AI platform to handle customer-support chats and call transcripts beginning next quarter.
shared_context.S2: The vendor has provided a draft agreement for review, including its standard data-use, liability, insurance, and audit provisions.
shared_context.S3: Elena Marquez gives final approval before the company signs.
shared_context.S4: The contract-approval workflow requires privacy, insurance, and customer-contracts counsel each to submit a formal finding to the case record before Elena decides. Each counsel is given a scheduled turn to state the complete finding, and once all three findings have been disclosed, Elena immediately issues the final settlement action rather than opening further coordination or re-review.

PF1.text: While reviewing the proposed data flows against the company's privacy inventory, Daniel confirmed that the platform will process identifiable customer call transcripts. The company's approved data-processing standard therefore requires deletion within exactly 7 calendar days after termination, prohibits use of customer content for model training or service improvement, and requires processing exclusively in the European Union; these points have not yet been entered in the contract redline.

PF2.text: Maya confirmed with the company's insurance broker that the cyber policy covers this deployment only if the vendor maintains at least $5,000,000 of cyber-liability insurance and names the company as an additional insured. She received the broker's written confirmation yesterday but has not added it to the approval checklist.

PF3.text: Thomas reviewed the enterprise customer's existing master agreement and confirmed that the company may use an AI subcontractor for support only if the subcontractor grants an annual audit right and accepts uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches. He has not yet incorporated those flow-down requirements into the vendor agreement.

acceptance_conditions: Customer content must be deleted exactly 7 calendar days after termination.
The vendor must be prohibited from using customer content for model training or service improvement.
Processing must be restricted to the European Union.
The vendor must maintain at least $5,000,000 of cyber-liability insurance.
The company must be named as an additional insured.
The agreement must grant an annual audit right.
Confidentiality and personal-data breach indemnity must be uncapped.
A commitment must incorporate the exact privacy requirements into the contract redline.
A commitment must incorporate the exact insurance requirements into the contract redline.
A commitment must incorporate the exact customer-contract flow-down requirements into the contract redline.

content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['privacy_redline', 'redline_incorporation', 'redline_coordination', 'redline', 'contract_redline'] and c['detail'] in ['7-day deletion; no model training or service improvement; European Union-only processing', 'Incorporate 7-calendar-day deletion after termination, prohibition on use of customer content for model training or service improvement, and EU-only processing into the vendor agreement redline.', 'Draft and log formal privacy finding covering 7-calendar-day deletion, prohibition on model training/service-improvement use, and EU-only processing; circulate redline language for data-use provisions', 'Incorporate deletion within exactly 7 calendar days after termination, prohibition on use of customer content for model training or service improvement, and processing exclusively in the European Union.', 'All three counsel to coordinate on a single, consistent set of redline revisions addressing privacy requirements (7-day deletion, no model training, EU-only processing), insurance requirements ($5M cyber coverage, additional insured), and customer-contract flow-downs (annual audit right, uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches).'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['insurance_redline', 'redline_incorporation', 'redline_coordination', 'redline', 'contract_redline'] and c['detail'] in ['$5,000,000 minimum cyber-liability coverage; company named as additional insured', 'Add $5,000,000 cyber-liability insurance requirement and additional-insured designation to the vendor agreement redline.', 'Draft and log formal insurance finding covering $5,000,000 cyber-liability coverage and additional-insured designation; circulate redline language for insurance provisions', 'Vendor must maintain at least $5,000,000 in cyber-liability insurance and name the company as an additional insured.', 'All three counsel to coordinate on a single, consistent set of redline revisions addressing privacy requirements (7-day deletion, no model training, EU-only processing), insurance requirements ($5M cyber coverage, additional insured), and customer-contract flow-downs (annual audit right, uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches).'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c['type'] in ['customer_flow_down', 'redline_incorporation', 'redline_coordination', 'redline', 'contract_redline'] and c['detail'] in ['annual audit right; uncapped confidentiality and personal-data breach indemnity', 'Incorporate annual audit right and uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches as flow-down provisions into the vendor agreement redline.', 'Draft and log formal customer-contracts finding covering annual audit right and uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches; circulate redline language for flow-down provisions', 'Vendor must grant an annual audit right and accept uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches.', 'All three counsel to coordinate on a single, consistent set of redline revisions addressing privacy requirements (7-day deletion, no model training, EU-only processing), insurance requirements ($5M cyber coverage, additional insured), and customer-contract flow-downs (annual audit right, uncapped indemnity for confidentiality and personal-data breaches).'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The applicable privacy standard changes the contract to exactly 7 days of deletion, no model-training or service-improvement use, and European-Union-only processing, requiring those exact redline terms.
The broker's condition changes the insurance terms to at least $5,000,000 of vendor cyber coverage and company additional-insured status, requiring those exact insurance provisions.
The customer's master agreement changes the vendor terms to an annual audit right and uncapped confidentiality and personal-data breach indemnity, requiring those exact flow-down provisions.
